steps.title: Wall
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as chassis.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane: circles diameter 180 and 176. Extrude 29 mm (the wall).
Sketch a circle diameter 176 on the XZ Plane, offset 25 mm. Extrude 2 mm, Join (the deck).
steps.note: One moulding in polypropylene: the same plastic as every other moulded part, so the case recycles as one.

steps.title: Hub hole
actions: Hole on the deck, on the centre: diameter 85, Through All.
steps.note: The hub of the carousel passes down through this hole to the drive gear.

steps.title: Drop hole
actions: Sketch on the deck: a ring segment from radius 44 to 78, 10.4 degrees wide, at the front. Extrude Cut Through All.
steps.note: Only one compartment is ever over this hole, so the patient can only ever get one dose.

steps.title: Screw bosses
actions: Sketch circles diameter 8 at radius 60 on 45 degrees, under the deck. Extrude down to the bottom of the wall. Circular Pattern 4.
Hole diameter 2.5, 10 deep, from the bottom of each boss (for the cover screws).

steps.title: Drawer opening
actions: Sketch a 46 x 11.5 rectangle on the XY Plane at the front, 6.5 up. Extrude Cut through the front wall.

steps.title: Lock hole
actions: Work plane at -55 degrees. Hole diameter 16 through the wall, 16 up from the bottom of the case, for the pharmacy cam lock.

steps.title: Hinge knuckles
actions: Sketch the two lugs on the YZ Plane at the back and extrude them 28 mm each side of the middle, 16 to 44 mm out; add a circle radius 3.5 at y 93.5, z 34 and Extrude, Join.
Hole diameter 3 along the hinge axis, Through All.
steps.note: The lid knuckle fits between them.

steps.title: Catch slot
actions: Sketch a 21.5 x 8.3 rectangle on the deck at the edge, at -55 degrees. Extrude Cut Through All. Save.
steps.note: The catch on the lid passes down through this slot to the cam of the lock.
